attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: sent_email_history_ingestion
steps:
  - id: authenticate_service
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "email_agent_service"
    output: auth_result

  - id: fetch_sent_emails
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/gmail/sent"
      query:
        date_range: "past_month_excluding_last_2_weeks"
    output: raw_sent_emails

  - id: validate_sent_emails
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_sent_emails
      schema: sent_email_schema
    output: validated_emails

  - id: filter_short_bodies
    op: filter_records
    params:
      input: validated_emails
      condition: "body IS NOT NULL AND length(body) >= 20"
    output: filtered_emails

  - id: loop_emails
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: filtered_emails
      step: build_chunks_per_email
    output: all_email_chunks

  - id: build_chunks_per_email
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: filtered_emails
      mapping:
        operation: "chunk_emails"
        combine_fields:
          - "subject"
          - "date"
          - "recipient"
          - "body"
        chunk_size: 500
        chunk_overlap: 50
        chunk_id_template: "sent-{messageId}-chunk-{index}"
    output: structured_chunks

  - id: embed_chunks
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: structured_chunks
      url: "/api/embeddings/generate"
      method: "POST"
      payload_field: "text_chunks"
    output: raw_embedded_chunks

  - id: validate_embeddings
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_embedded_chunks
      schema: embedding_result_schema
    output: validated_embedded_chunks

  - id: insert_into_vector_store
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: validated_embedded_chunks
      table: "vector_store"
      namespace: "email-history"
    output: write_result

  - id: log_ingestion
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: write_result
      message: "Sent email history ingestion completed"
      details:
        namespace: "email-history"
        trigger: "weekly_schedule"

  - id: handle_ingestion_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      step: insert_into_vector_store
      action: "retry_then_notify"

  - id: retry_vector_insert
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step: insert_into_vector_store
      retries: 3
      backoff: "exponential"

  - id: notify_on_failure
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: write_result
      recipient: "admin@club.com"
      message: "Sent email history ingestion failed after retries"
      channel: "email"

    output: filtered_emails

  - id: build_chunks
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: filtered_emails
      mapping:
        operation: chunk_emails
        combine_fields:
          - subject
          - date
          - recipient
          - body
        chunk_size: 500
        chunk_overlap: 50
        chunk_id_template: sent-{messageId}-chunk-{index}
    output: structured_chunks

  - id: prepare_embedding_request
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: structured_chunks
      mapping:
        model: embedding_model
        payload_field: text_chunks
        namespace: email-history
    output: embedding_request

  - id: embed_chunks
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: embedding_request
      url: /api/embeddings/generate
      method: POST
    output: raw_embedded_chunks

  - id: validate_embeddings
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_embedded_chunks
      schema: embedding_result_schema
    output: validated_embedded_chunks

  - id: transform_vector_upsert_payload
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_embedded_chunks
      mapping:
        operation: vector_store_upsert_payload
        namespace: email-history
        index_target: email_history_namespace
    output: vector_upsert_payload

  - id: insert_into_vector_store
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: vector_upsert_payload
      url: /api/vector-store/index
      method: POST
    output: index_result

  - id: validate_index_result
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: index_result
      schema: index_result_schema
    output: validated_index_result

  - id: extract_index_summary
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_index_result
      field: summary
    output: index_summary

  - id: log_ingestion
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: index_summary
      message: Sent email history ingestion completed
      details:
        namespace: email-history
        trigger: weekly_schedule
